complexity.notes: No early exit: 'valid *= isValidLine(...)' keeps scanning all lines even after a failure; 'valid &= ...' or 'return False' would be cleaner. The count-based duplicate check is concise but quadratic per line; a set would be more idiomatic for larger inputs. Also 'List' needs a typing import.
complexity.summary: Checks each row, column, and 3x3 box for duplicate digits using list.count on every non-empty cell. Since the board is fixed at 9x9, all work is constant; generalized to n cells per line it would be O(n^2) per line due to repeated count scans.
